stories.title: India car market defies global slowdown
stories.summary: India is on track to sell over 30 million vehicles in the current financial year, according to the Federation of Automobile Dealers Associations. While major markets like China and the United States face weakening sales, India is positioning itself as a primary destination for global automotive investment.

stories.title: India’s BEV penetration rises to 7.4% in FY27, new model launches, improving affordability to drive furthe.. - ET Auto
Electric passenger vehicle sales accelerate
stories.summary: Electric passenger vehicle sales have reached 2.59 lakh units as of November 25, surpassing the total recorded for the entire 2026 fiscal year. Market penetration has climbed to 7.6 percent, up from 4.6 percent. The milestone was achieved with over three months remaining in the fiscal year.

stories.title: West Bengal eyes industrial return to Singur
stories.summary: The West Bengal government is working to reacquire 997 acres of land in Singur to host a new commercial vehicle plant for Ashok Leyland. The site was previously the location of a high-stakes industrial row involving the Tata Nano. Officials say the move signals an industrial revival.

Royal Enfield signs ₹1,000 crore MoU with Tamil Nadu government for EV expansion - HT Auto
Tata AutoComp Systems inaugurates 3 manufacturing plants in Gujarat - ET Auto
Bikewo invests in green mobility fleet
stories.summary: BikeWo Green Tech has approved an investment of 15 crore rupees to acquire a 25 percent stake in Green Drive Mobility. The company plans to deploy a fleet of 10,000 electric two-wheelers and 5,000 electric trucks across India, following a strategic memorandum signed in October.

stories.title: Toyota Innova HyCross Flex Hybrid launched in India, prices start from ₹19.99 lakhs - evo India
Toyota launches flex-fuel hybrid Innova
stories.summary: Toyota Kirloskar Motor has launched the Innova HyCross Flex Hybrid, described as the country's first flex-fuel strong hybrid vehicle. The model runs on ethanol blends ranging from E20 to E85. Prices start at 19.99 lakh rupees, with bookings now open for the updated lineup.

stories.title: Toyota replaces strong hybrid with flex-fuel version
stories.summary: Toyota has introduced a flex-fuel version of the Innova Hycross, replacing the existing strong-hybrid powertrain. The new model, priced from 19.99 lakh rupees, is now the sole hybrid offering in the lineup. Customers no longer have the option to purchase the conventional strong-hybrid version.

stories.title: Mahindra updates BE 6 with SPORTEQ variant
stories.summary: Mahindra has introduced the BE 6 SPORTEQ, an electric SUV variant featuring 12 exterior color options and updated interior themes. The company says the model aims to combine zero-emission motoring with distinctive styling and performance to fit seamlessly into the everyday lives of its buyers.

stories.title: JSW opens applications for 500-unit Combat SUV special edition ahead of December debut - ET Auto
JSW Motors sets mid-January delivery target
stories.summary: JSW Motors has announced that deliveries for its first SUV, the Jetour T2-based Combat, will begin in mid-January 2027. The first 500 buyers will be offered a special pioneer edition. Registration for the limited release opens on November 28 with a 1 lakh rupee deposit.

stories.title: Hyundai to debut compact electric SUV in 2027
stories.summary: Hyundai Motor India plans to unveil the Ioniq P EV on January 16, 2027, with a public debut scheduled for the India Global Mobility Expo in February. The vehicle will be manufactured at the company's Sriperumbudur plant to target the affordable electric SUV segment.

stories.title: Mahindra plans 16 new models by 2031
stories.summary: Mahindra expects to launch 16 new models by 2031, including 10 internal combustion vehicles and 6 electric vehicles. The Vision S and BE 07 SUVs are scheduled for release in 2027, marking the debut of the brand's new NU_IQ and INGLO platforms respectively.

stories.title: Mahindra maintains 4x4 lineup despite low demand
stories.summary: Mahindra is preparing to launch three new 4x4 SUVs, including a new pickup truck. The company says it continues to offer 4x4 variants to protect its core brand identity, despite noting that only a small portion of its customers actually opt for the off-road capability.

stories.title: Greaves Electric targets 2x sales volume for Ampere escooter in FY27
stories.summary: Greaves Electric Mobility expects to double sales volume for its Ampere brand this financial year, according to MD Vikas Singh. Registrations reached 72,000 units through October, surpassing the 62,644 units recorded for the entirety of the previous financial year. The company expects to easily reach its target.

stories.title: Ampere partners with CSC Grameen eStore for rural sales pilot
stories.summary: Ampere, a subsidiary of Greaves Electric Mobility, has partnered with CSC Grameen eStore to sell electric scooters in rural markets. The pilot program begins in Tamil Nadu, Bihar, Odisha and Maharashtra. The company announced the move via a regulatory filing on 26 November 2026.

stories.title: Hero MotoCorp expands Harley-Davidson partnership with new dealerships
stories.summary: Hero MotoCorp has expanded its Harley-Davidson dealer network to 23 locations, including new outlets in Raipur and Indore. The company reports that the Harley-Davidson X range has contributed over 50,000 units since its 2023 launch. The brand's Indian H.O.G. network now exceeds 3,000 members.

Brixton Crossfire 500 Storr reaches dealerships ahead of launch
stories.summary: The Brixton Crossfire 500 Storr has appeared at a Motohaus dealership in Hyderabad ahead of its expected early 2027 market debut. A video of the middle-weight adventure motorcycle shows the instrument cluster, fuel tank and seats. The bike was unveiled from under a white veil for the recording.

stories.title: Mini Cooper SE India launch set for November 27
stories.summary: The new Mini Cooper SE launches in India on 27 November 2026, featuring a 54.2kWh battery and a claimed WLTP range of 402 km. MINI will also introduce Paul Smith Editions of the Cooper SE, Cooper S and Cooper Convertible alongside the standard electric hatchback model.

stories.title: Honda Alpha EV teased ahead of December 2 debut
stories.summary: Honda has teased the front fascia of its upcoming Alpha electric SUV ahead of a 2 December 2026 launch. The image shows an LED light bar and dual ice cube-shaped headlights. The brand previously shared design sketches of the vehicle interior to build anticipation for the debut.

stories.title: Honda Alpha EV teaser highlights front design
stories.summary: Honda released a new teaser for the Alpha electric SUV, showcasing the front bumper and LED DRL styling. The vehicle is scheduled to debut in India on 2 December 2026. The company has been sharing various design elements of the SUV throughout the week.

stories.title: Tata Punch EV records 5,000 monthly sales milestone
stories.summary: The Tata Punch EV became the first electric passenger vehicle in India to exceed 5,000 monthly dispatches in October 2026. The broader electric passenger vehicle market grew 75% year-on-year to 39,170 units. Market growth is attributed to an expanding product portfolio and increased consumer acceptance.

stories.title: Chennai auto drivers face barriers to EV adoption
stories.summary: A survey of 1,008 auto-rickshaw drivers in Chennai found that 70% are interested in switching to electric vehicles. However, high upfront costs, reliance on rented vehicles and limited charging infrastructure remain significant obstacles. The study was conducted by the Citizen consumer and civic Action Group.

stories.title: Powering India's EV revolution : Indofast Energy crosses 100 million battery swaps - 5 Dariya News
Volkswagen launches bi-directional charging in Germany
stories.summary: Volkswagen subsidiary Elli has launched a bi-directional charger in Germany, offering a €720 bonus in the first year. The company claims the vehicle-to-grid setup could offset electricity costs equivalent to 10,000 miles of driving. The charger is compatible with Volkswagen, Cupra and Skoda electric vehicles.

stories.title: Delhi government to add 540 EV chargers across 180 locations - HT Auto
Nio bets on partners to reach 10,000 swap stations by 2030 - Automotive World
Somerset Council advances electric vehicle charging initiatives
stories.summary: Somerset Council is moving to the next phase of two electric vehicle charging projects funded by a £3.783 million grant. The council previously withdrew from a contract with a chargepoint operator, citing a need to refine its delivery approach and better reflect the needs of local communities.

stories.title: Scotland plans major electric vehicle charging expansion
stories.summary: Charging operator EZO will deliver 250 new electric vehicle charging sites across the north of Scotland by 2030. The £7 million project is funded by the Scottish Government and involves four local authorities. The first site is now operational at the Aviemore Community and Leisure Centre.

stories.title: European manufacturers explore vehicle-to-grid potential
stories.summary: The European Automobile Manufacturers’ Association hosted a demonstration of vehicle-to-grid technology to highlight how electric cars can feed electricity back into the grid. The exhibition aimed to connect the automotive and energy sectors to manage energy use more efficiently.

stories.title: Kim Long Motor delivers 100 electric sleeper buses in Vietnam
stories.summary: Kim Long Motor delivered 100 electric sleeper buses to Futa Bus Lines. The company says it achieved 60 per cent localisation and aims for 90 per cent by year-end, prioritising motors and batteries. It produces batteries at its own plant with technical support from BYD.

stories.title: China releases battery swapping standard for commercial vehicles
stories.summary: China released a technical standard for chassis-mounted battery swapping in commercial vehicles. Drafted by CATL, the move aims to unify battery pack dimensions to enable heavy-duty trucks to swap power across different networks. The industry previously lacked a unified standard for the components.

stories.title: LGMG unveils electric mining truck at Bauma China
stories.summary: LGMG debuted its VTH150 electric-wheel mining truck at the Bauma China 2026 exhibition. The vehicle is designed for heavy-duty hauling in mining environments. The company presented the model as part of its expanding electric vehicle lineup for industrial applications.

stories.title: Adani Cement begins electric truck fleet deployment
stories.summary: Adani Cement deployed its first heavy-duty electric trucks in Gujarat. The company plans to introduce 410 electric vehicles by March 2027 and aims to operate over 2,000 by 2030. It expects the transition to replace 11 million litres of diesel consumption annually.

Auto parts makers outpace carmakers in profit growth
stories.summary: Indian auto-component manufacturers recorded 17 per cent EBIT growth in the September quarter, compared to 8 per cent for vehicle manufacturers, according to Jefferies. The report analysed 20 leading companies, noting that parts makers outperformed despite facing similar revenue growth and rising input costs.

stories.title: Auto parts makers outperform carmakers in profit growth: Jefferies
stories.summary: New Delhi [India], November 26 (ANI): Indian auto-component manufacturers reported stronger profit growth than vehicle manufacturers in the September quarter, with their earnings rising at more than twice the pace of original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), according to a report by Jefferies. The report analysed the September quarter financial performance and

stories.title: Apollo Tyres sets cut-off for debenture ballot
stories.summary: Apollo Tyres fixed November 27 as the cut-off date for shareholders to vote on a private placement of non-convertible debentures. The board approved the proposal on November 4. Eligible shareholders will receive notice for the postal ballot and e-voting facility.

stories.title: Bridgestone extends Lamborghini partnership to Temerario Spyder as exclusive tyre supplier - ET Auto
Continental extends Mercedes-Benz tyre partnership
stories.summary: Continental extended its status as a preferred tyre partner for Mercedes-Benz in India and the APAC region until August 2027. The agreement grants Continental access to central ordering tools and sales platforms within the Mercedes-Benz network. The two companies will continue joint promotional activities.

stories.title: Tyre makers face testing hurdles for BS7 emission norms
stories.summary: Proposed Bharat Stage 7 regulations will introduce limits on tyre wear, requiring manufacturers to develop new testing infrastructure. Bridgestone India managing director Rajarshi Moitra noted that the industry must establish measurement criteria and validation protocols over the next few years to comply with the new standards.

stories.title: Oetiker India doubles manufacturing capacity
stories.summary: Oetiker India inaugurated an expanded manufacturing facility to mark 20 years of operations. The company says the investment increases production capacity and strengthens its ability to serve customers across India and the ASEAN region. It focuses on precision connecting technology for the automotive sector.

Gujarat festive auto retail sales decline nearly 3%, car sales fall 9% - ET Auto
Kia India Partners Spinny For Vehicle Exchange, Trade-In And Certified Pre-Owned Car Sales - ACKO Drive
Kia India joins hands with Spinny to streamline vehicle upgrades and pre-owned sales - ET Auto
Kia India and Spinny partner on pre-owned cars
stories.summary: Kia India has partnered with the used car platform Spinny to manage vehicle exchanges and certified pre-owned sales. Customers trading in a Kia for a new model at an authorised dealership qualify for exchange benefits. Qualifying vehicles will be sold as Kia-Certified. The process is now officially linked.

stories.title: Honda Motorcycle and Scooter India targets dealer margins
stories.summary: HMSI president Tsutsumu Otani says the firm will focus on dealer margins and buyer retention to grow its units in operation. During April to October, the company dispatched 3.7 million units, trailing Hero MotoCorp by 300,000. Business, according to the executive, is not just one year.

stories.title: Invicta Motors opens seventh Chery dealership
stories.summary: Invicta Motors has opened its seventh Chery dealership in Bolton, expanding the parent company Cambria Group's footprint in the North West. The showroom offers new car sales, test drives, and part-exchange services. Chery Group entered the UK passenger car market in 2025 and is growing.

stories.title: Cambria Automobiles expands Chery footprint
stories.summary: Dealer group Cambria Automobiles is opening its seventh Chery dealership in Bolton, strengthening its relationship with the manufacturer. The group now operates seven Chery and six Omoda and Jaecoo locations. Chery has grown since its 1997 founding into one of China's largest vehicle manufacturers.

stories.title: Legado Car Sales Inc. Earns Gold Bagwis Award, the Highest DTI Recognition for Excellence in Customer Service - Manila S
JSW MG Motor India reports 25 percent growth
stories.summary: JSW MG Motor India reported 8,013 units sold in October, a 25 percent increase year-on-year. While ICE sales jumped 416.67 percent from a low base, EV sales grew 3.56 percent. The brand's total sales remained nearly flat compared to September, declining 0.06 percent.

stories.title: Muthoot Capital reports profit increase
stories.summary: Muthoot Capital Services reported a standalone net profit of 440.25 lakh for the quarter ended September 30, a 55.7 percent increase year-on-year. Total income rose 15.2 percent to 1,789.22 lakh. The growth was supported by rising interest income, which offset higher finance and impairment costs.

stories.title: Kinetic Engineering reports EV sales momentum
stories.summary: Kinetic Engineering reported over 7,000 cumulative electric scooter sales and an increase in promoter stake to 65 percent. The company expects its EV business to add 100 crore to consolidated revenue in FY27. It targets a 400,000 unit run-rate by FY30 with 5 percent market share.

stories.title: Tata Motors increases stake in ACGL via buyback
stories.summary: Tata Motors has become a majority shareholder in Automobile Corporation of Goa Limited, with its stake rising from 48.98 percent to 50.17 percent. The increase followed a share buyback by ACGL. Tata Motors achieved this majority threshold without purchasing a single additional share.

stories.title: Tata Motors consolidates ACGL as subsidiary
stories.summary: Tata Motors' stake in Automobile Corporation of Goa Limited rose to 50.17 percent following a buyback of 144,639 equity shares. The company is now a consolidated subsidiary rather than an associate. Tata Motors acquired no new shares to reach this majority position.

stories.title: America’s Car-Mart seeks court-supervised capital
stories.summary: America’s Car-Mart has announced a plan to secure 60 million in new capital and reduce debt through a court-supervised sale. Dealerships remain open for account servicing. The company says trade creditors would be paid in full under the proposed plan, which is subject to court approval.

stories.title: Consumer forum directs BYD to inspect defective EV, pay compensation - ET Auto
FCA admits errors in motor finance scheme
stories.summary: The Financial Conduct Authority has admitted to calculation errors in its motor finance redress scheme. The regulator says the mistakes impacted compensation by less than 10 per agreement on average. These errors have sparked fresh delays to the scheme, which is already facing a legal challenge.

stories.title: Car finance compensation faces further delays
stories.summary: Millions of drivers mis-sold car finance face further delays to compensation after the FCA admitted to calculation errors. While average payments of 829 are expected, legal challenges mean payments are pushed to at least 2027. The regulator has not yet finalised the compensation timeline.

stories.title: Insurers warned of rising credit hire costs
stories.summary: A strategist has warned insurers to expect credit hire costs to rise by 19 percent next year for cases outside the General Terms of Agreement. Costs for claims covered by the agreement are also expected to rise by 11 percent through 2029 due to repair complexity.

stories.title: Qualcomm expands automotive AI investment
stories.summary: Qualcomm is increasing resources for driver-assistance and autonomous driving systems as competition in automotive AI chips intensifies. The chip designer is working with software-focused collaborators to secure contracts. Rivals are targeting the same infrastructure, putting pressure on the company's automotive revenue ambitions.

stories.title: Qualcomm expands automotive AI footprint
stories.summary: Qualcomm is deepening its role in autonomous driving as carmakers increase spending on high-performance processors for advanced AI workloads. While the company competes with rival chip and software suppliers for design wins, its broader automotive strategy continues to evolve alongside its existing autonomous driving partnerships.

AUTOCRYPT to present security solutions at CES 2027
stories.summary: AUTOCRYPT will showcase security solutions for the Physical AI ecosystem at CES 2027 in Las Vegas. The company plans to leverage its automotive cybersecurity portfolio to address emerging needs across robotics, defense, industrial machinery and biohealth. The firm is currently highlighting its expansion into software-defined vehicle platforms.

stories.title: Draft auto policy awaits cabinet approval
stories.summary: The draft Auto and Auto Parts Manufacturing Policy for 2026-31 proposes cutting customs duties in stages over five years. As of 25 November 2026, the draft requires federal cabinet approval and a money bill in Parliament. Showroom prices remain unchanged while the policy awaits these legislative steps.

stories.title: Industry groups lobby for EU origin rules
stories.summary: Four European industry associations, including EUROFER and CLEPA, are urging the European Parliament to set a 75-80 percent Union-origin threshold for vehicle components within the Industrial Accelerator Act. The groups argue that current proposals are insufficient to restore the competitiveness of the European automotive value chain.

stories.title: Supply chain groups seek higher EU content thresholds
stories.summary: EUROFER, CLEPA and other industry groups have requested that the EU Industrial Accelerator Act mandate a 75-80 percent Union-origin threshold for vehicle components. The associations stated that public funding must support European production capacity and job creation, urging lawmakers to maintain ambitious objectives for the automotive sector.

stories.title: USMCA auto content tariff deadline extended
stories.summary: The U.S. Department of Commerce has extended the deadline for automobile importers to document domestic value content under the USMCA until March 1, 2027. The decision provides manufacturers and research partners additional time to audit supply chains before facing potential national security tariffs.

stories.title: Proposed US tariffs target Indian goods
stories.summary: The USTR has proposed tariffs of up to 25 percent on Indian goods, excluding items already subject to Section 232 duties. The U.S. accounted for 26 percent of India’s automotive component exports in FY26. Existing 25 percent duties on specified auto parts will remain in effect.

stories.title: Glass for Europe supports anti-dumping probe
stories.summary: Glass for Europe has welcomed an EU anti-dumping investigation into automotive glazing imports from China. The association, which lodged the complaint, stated the move is necessary to ensure fair competition and safeguard European manufacturing capacity. Automotive glass is described as an increasingly sophisticated component of modern vehicles.

Indian Racing Festival arrives at Buddh International Circuit
stories.summary: The Indian Racing Festival begins a three-day event at the Buddh International Circuit on November 27. The schedule includes the F4 Indian Championship, the Indian Racing League and various displays featuring supercars and vintage vehicles. The event will also host motorsport stunts and entertainment activities.

stories.title: Indian Racing Festival returns to Buddh International Circuit
stories.summary: The Indian Racing Festival will host three days of motorsport and entertainment at the Buddh International Circuit from November 27 to 29. The event features the FIA-certified F4 Indian Championship and the Indian Racing League, alongside drifting displays, vintage cars, and various high-performance vehicle demonstrations.

stories.title: F4 and Indian Racing League head to Buddh
stories.summary: The Indian Racing Festival returns to the Buddh International Circuit starting November 27. The weekend is headlined by the FIA-certified F4 Indian Championship and the Indian Racing League, with JK Formula LGB 4 running as a support race. Racing action begins on the track this Saturday.

stories.title: Buddh Circuit hosts three-day racing festival
stories.summary: The Indian Racing Festival arrives at the Buddh International Circuit from November 27 to 29. The schedule includes the F4 Indian Championship, the Indian Racing League, and JK Formula LGB 4. The event also features stunt displays and exhibitions of supercars, superbikes, and vintage vehicles.

stories.title: Kolkata Royal Tigers eye Buddh circuit gains
stories.summary: The Kolkata Royal Tigers franchise, owned by Sourav Ganguly, heads to the Buddh International Circuit for the latest rounds of the Indian Racing League and F4 Indian Championship. The team recently secured a podium finish in the IRL and a maiden victory in the F4 championship.

stories.title: Preparations underway for return of F1 to India: Sports Minister Mandaviya - DD News
'Being the youngest race winner is sweeter': Aaron Mehta reflects on F4 Indian Championship success - The Hawk
Qatar Grand Prix 2026 schedule for Indian viewers
stories.summary: The 2026 Formula 1 Qatar Airways Qatar Grand Prix takes place from November 27 to 29 at the Lusail International Circuit. The main race is scheduled for Sunday evening, starting at 9:30 PM IST. The weekend includes practice sessions, qualifying, and FIA Formula 2 races.

stories.title: Renault targets five-tonne lifecycle carbon footprint
stories.summary: Renault Group aims to reduce the lifecycle carbon footprint of future vehicles to five tonnes of CO2. The company reported a 22 percent reduction in global emissions between 2019 and 2025. It targets climate neutrality in Europe by 2040 and worldwide by 2050 through design and electrification.

stories.title: Ford Puma Gen-E earns 96% Green NCAP sustainability rating - Automotive World
Volvo reflects on 50 years of electric prototypes
stories.summary: Volvo is marking the 50th anniversary of its first electric vehicle, the Elbil. The company built two prototypes in 1976, including a butter-yellow delivery van intended for local trips. Developers at the time were already grappling with the challenge of vehicle weight.

stories.title: Volvo marks 50 years since first electric car - Fleet World
Chinese electric truck surge creates global demand
stories.summary: China’s electric truck manufacturing dominance is driving demand for critical minerals globally. While local assembly offers a starting point for resource-rich nations, analysts note that displacing diesel fleets requires more than imports, citing the need for grid capacity, reliable charging infrastructure, and domestic technical training.

stories.title: European manufacturers scale back electric truck expectations
stories.summary: Battery-electric trucks are not expected to overtake diesel in German heavy commercial vehicle registrations until 2035. European manufacturers have significantly reduced their expectations compared to 2024, according to data presented at a recent transport ministry conference in Berlin. Optimism remains, though the timeline has shifted.

stories.title: Electrified vehicles drive European car market growth
stories.summary: New car sales in Europe rose 5.4 percent in the first 10 months of the year. Electrified vehicles accounted for 23.4 percent of the market, while hybrids captured 36 percent. The combined market share of petrol and diesel vehicles fell during the same period.

stories.title: Avatr expands into Swiss market
stories.summary: Chinese electric vehicle brand Avatr is entering Switzerland following its debut in Paris. The company is partnering with Kamps Import AG and Schmohl AG to establish a sales network. A showroom is scheduled to open in Zürich Oerlikon during the first quarter of 2027.

Xiaomi's car division posts big loss for the third quarter in a row as 2026 Xiaomi SU7 and YU7 sales slow - CarsGuide
Xpeng targets European sales growth
stories.summary: Chinese electric vehicle maker Xpeng aims to double its European sales next year. The company plans to expand local production as it seeks to compete with Tesla. Beyond vehicle sales, Xpeng is also developing robotaxi and humanoid robot businesses.

Xiaomi sets 2027 date for European electric vehicle launch
stories.summary: Xiaomi plans to enter the German market in the third quarter of 2027, with subsequent launches planned for Sweden, Spain and Italy. The company will conduct functional verification at seven test sites across the four countries. The car business is currently facing mounting performance pressure at home.

Philippines sets fire safety rules for electric vehicles on ferries
stories.summary: The Maritime Industry Authority has issued interim requirements for carrying electric and hybrid vehicles on domestic vessels. Operators must now ensure cargo spaces have fixed fire extinguishing systems and prohibit onboard charging. Owners must declare battery status and damage before loading. The sea remains a difficult place for batteries.

research.title: Best-of-$N$ Test-Time Steering Can Lead to Reward Hacking in Vision-Language-Action Models
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown promise for general-purpose robotic manipulation, but adapting to changing environmental conditions still remains challenging. Recent test-time steering methods have shown promise in enabling adaptive VLA policies by utilizing additional computation during. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Decentralized Control Barrier Function Filters for Frequency Containment With Inverters
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper addresses the design of safety filters for grid-following (GFL) inverters in power transmission systems. The goal of the filters is to constrain frequency nadir and zenith following generation-demand imbalances, by supplementing primary frequency control. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Fuel-Efficient Formation Flying via Constrained Extremum Seeking
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper presents a model-free autonomous guidance architecture for minimal drag of a trailing aircraft in formation flight. Realizing the fuel savings resulting from such a formation requires learning and tracking a time-varying vortex while avoiding. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Greedy Decoding Hides Good Plans: Sample-and-Verify Planning for Vision-Language Driving Models
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly adopted for end-to-end driving planning, yet their performance is typically evaluated based on a single greedily decoded trajectory. However, greedy decoding may overlook better trajectories within the model's output distribution. Experiments. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Impact of the Performance of Autonomy and Communication Subsystems on the Level-of-Safety of Partially Autonomous Machine Systems
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: The level-of-safety of a partially autonomous machine system depends on two subsystems: the autonomy subsystem that manages the system between human interventions, and the communication subsystem that enables those interventions. These subsystems are typically evaluated independently. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Learning a Whole-Body Pivot-Walking Gait for Heavy-Box Transport with a Humanoid
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Through pivot walking, humans can transport objects that are too heavy to lift. Previous humanoid studies have relied on planned sequences in which object manipulation and stepping are executed separately and the object is brought to. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
